The '''battle near Athega''' was a space battle between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that took place in or near the [[Athega system]].

==The Battle==
Eleven [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Rebel blockade runners]] forming the convoy group [[Athega (corvette group)|''Athega'']] were being escorted through [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] by [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing starfighters]] from [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]]. With several minutes to go before the corvettes reached their [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] point, a force of long-range Imperial starfighters entered the system. [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]] engaged Gold Squadron, which may have called in additional support from [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] to assist, and [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] began making [[Proton torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] runs against the Rebel convoy.

Not quite four minutes into the fight, the [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|Calamari Cruiser]] [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']] entered the system. It deployed [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]], a force of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing superiority starfighters]], from a safe distance. The [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] may have deployed the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Aggressor (Victory-class)|''Aggressor'']] into the system to counter the Rebel threat if its fighter groups called for reinforcements.

==Behind the scenes==
As players can participate in the mission "Attack on Rebel Convoy near Athega" in the computer game ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]'' on either the Rebel or the Imperial side&mdash;both sides have conflicting mission objectives&mdash;and victory is not essential to access the next set of missions, the battle itself is considered canon but the canon outcome is unknown.

The ships listed in this article are those found in the battle [[Operation: Quick Strike]], using the default craft assigned to the player.

The combat engagement is said to take place in a neutral system "near Athega". Whether Athega is intended to be a celestial body (which could place this battle in the Athega system) or the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] is unclear; the only certainty is that this combat engagement did not take place in deep space between star systems.
